name: – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission implementing decision renewing the authorisation for the placing on the market of products containing, consisting of or produced from genetically modified soybean MON 87705 pursuant to Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to withdraw its plan to renew the licence for importing a genetically modified soybean called MON 87705. This soybean is engineered to tolerate glyphosate, a weedkiller. The Parliament says the safety checks were incomplete and that growing this crop leads to more herbicide use, which harms soil, water and wildlife. The Parliament also says Member States never backed the plan. This is an opinion; the Parliament cannot block the licence itself.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament only asks the Commission to drop the plan.
- **Who it affects:** Farmers, food and feed importers, and consumers in the EU.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to withdraw or go ahead.
